programme.title: Carving Light in the Darkness: Najeonjang
programme.desc: Najeonjang refers to the craft of decorating lacquerware with mother-of-pearl designs or the craftsmen who practice this skill. Appreciate the beauty of traditional Najeonjang. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Carving Blessings into Rice Cake Mold: Wood Carving Master
programme.desc: Delicate patterns carved into small wooden molds are more than decorations—they carry heartfelt wishes for good fortune. The sound of carving reveals the timeless devotion behind traditional confections. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Embodying Wishes in Paper: Jihwa Master
programme.desc: Jihwa has been used not only in the royal court but also in family celebrations, Buddhist ceremonies, and shamanic rituals since ancient times. A Jihwa master is an artisan who cuts and decorates paper to create adornments for ceremonies. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Welcome Spring: Royal Confectionery Spring Table
programme.desc: Capturing the perfect snack that matches spring best, the sounds of making royal confectionery. Experience the taste and style filled with the scent of spring. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Legacy of Sound: Daegeum Master
programme.desc: Daegeum, which is one of Korea's representative traditional instruments is a wind instrument with holes drilled into bamboo to produce sound. Let’s follow the work process of these artisans who keep the tradition alive. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Patience in Preserving Tradition: Onggi Master
programme.desc: Onggi, which every Korean household used to have at least four or five, if not dozens, were essential in traditional Korean kitchens. Feel the patience in preserving the tradition of Onggi masters. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Secret Garden: Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace EP.2
programme.desc: Nakseonjae combines noble residence style with palace architecture, featuring unique decorative patterns that showcase late Joseon craftsmanship. Enjoy a break at the exclusive Rear Garden of Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Autumn Forest of the Royal Tombs: With Queen Inhyeon's Tears, SeoOReung
programme.desc: Named for its five royal tombs, Seoreung in Goyang is the second-largest royal tomb cluster of the Joseon Dynasty. Explore its vast, well-preserved natural forest paths, known as "Shinrim" (Divine Forest). (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Mystical Hidden Scenery: Jusanji Pond, Cheongsong EP.3
programme.desc: Completed in 1720, Jusanji Pond is fed by clear waters from Byeolbawi Rock and surrounded by lush forests of Juwangsan Mountain, creating a serene, otherworldly atmosphere. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Taste of Tradition: Making Makgeolli
programme.desc: Makgeolli Brewing,' is a part of our everyday culture and a National Intangible Cultural Heritage. Experience the Makgeolli from Jeoncheon Deoksan Brewery, which adheres to traditional techniques. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Brewing Scarlet Spirit: Jindo Red Liquor
programme.desc: Made from clear water, grains, and nuruk, Jindo Red Liquor reveals a deep crimson hue and rich aroma through fermentation and distillation. This traditional liquor carries the delicate legacy of women’s hands across generations. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Artistic Peak of Knotting: Knot Master
programme.desc: Knot Masters are artisans who use strings to make various types of knots and tassels. Appreciate the works of Knot Masters who have reached the height of art in Dahoe knot making. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Exquisite Details of Joseon: Traditional Headwear
programme.desc: With threads finer than hair, artisans weave traditional headgear that once reflected dignity and etiquette. Manggeon and Tanggeon, more than mere accessories, embody the refined aesthetic of Joseon craftsmanship. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.desc: ムン部長からテグへの転勤を命じられたドンチは、仁川での残された日々で４人の権力者を逮捕するため全力を挙げる。権力者のうちの１人、美容整形クリニックのチュ院長を落とすことが全員の逮捕につながると見たドンチは、チュ院長の犯罪を証言できる女をチャンギの家にかくまうのだが…。

programme.title: 傲慢と偏見、12回 12話
programme.desc: チャンギが目を離した隙に証言者の女が襲われ病院に運ばれる。ドンチはチュ院長を追い詰め、キム議員の収賄についても調べを進めていく。そんな中、ムン部長は突然ドンチに捜査の中止を命じる。あきらめる気のないドンチはヨルムとカンを連れて捜査を続け、新たな証拠を手に入れるのだが…。

programme.title: 傲慢と偏見、13回 13話
programme.desc: ムン部長は検察局長のイ･ジョンゴンが自らが犯した罪を隠すべくドンチを殺そうとしていることを知る。一方、ドンチはチャンギが1999年の検察の特別捜査に協力して、自らが法務部長を務めていたジェゴングループの悪を正そうとしていたことを知り…。そんな中、ヨルムはドンチに連れられ、ビョルが殺害された現場に向かうのだが…。

programme.title: 傲慢と偏見、14回 14話
programme.desc: ドンチは自分の親しい先輩でソウル中央地検の検事、チェに過去の検察特捜部の行動について詳しい話を聞く。チェは1999年の特捜当時、チャンギと共に極秘裏に動いていたのはイ検察局長かムン部長だった可能性を示唆する。そんな中、仁川地検では突然ドンチの転勤辞令が取り消され…。

programme.title: 傲慢と偏見、15回 15話
programme.desc: ヨルムの弟の事件の参考人としてファヨン財団のパク･マングンを召還したドンチの元に、ファヨン財団の弁護士となったチャンギが現れる。カンはチャンギが自分の母親をひき逃げ事故で死なせた犯人だと知り、激しく動揺する。そんな中、イ検事が担当した事件とファヨン財団がつながることが分かり…。

programme.title: 傲慢と偏見、16回 16話
programme.desc: "ムン部長がヨルムの弟の誘拐を指示した容疑で拘束される。ソウル地検から特任検事として派遣されたチェ検事がムン部長の取り調べを指揮するが、ドンチは疑念を拭い切れず…。 一方、ファヨン財団の手先のオ次長はパク･マングンの犯罪証拠を渡さなければ“民生安定チーム”を解体するとドンチを脅す。"
